name: dsh-tool-skills
description: Agent Skills Marketplace - Skill discovery, composition, versioning, quality scoring, packaging, trigger optimization, analytics, and template generation for AI agent skills

skills.name: Skill Discoverer
skills.description: Discover and match skills to a task description using semantic analysis. Returns relevance scores, trigger confidence, and composition suggestions for available skills.
examples: Use Skill Discoverer to discover and match skills to a task description using semantic analysis. Returns relevance scores, trigger confidence, and composition suggestions for available skills.
Can you run Skill Discoverer? Task Description is the main input I have.
Invoke Skill Discoverer with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Skill Composer
skills.description: Compose multiple skills into a coordinated workflow. Generates dependency graphs, identifies failure points, and provides optimization hints for skill chains.
examples: Use Skill Composer to compose multiple skills into a coordinated workflow. Generates dependency graphs, identifies failure points, and provides optimization hints for skill chains.
Can you run Skill Composer? Skills is the main input I have.
Invoke Skill Composer with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Skill Version Manager
skills.description: Manage skill versioning with version trees, breaking change detection, upgrade paths, and rollback readiness assessment.
examples: Use Skill Version Manager to manage skill versioning with version trees, breaking change detection, upgrade paths, and rollback readiness assessment.

Invoke Skill Version Manager with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Skill Quality Scorer
skills.description: Score skill quality across multiple dimensions: completeness, trigger accuracy, instruction clarity, test coverage, and naming conventions. Returns letter grade and improvement suggestions.
examples: Use Skill Quality Scorer to score skill quality across multiple dimensions: completeness, trigger accuracy, instruction clarity, test coverage, and naming conventions. Returns letter grade and improvement suggestions.

Invoke Skill Quality Scorer with the relevant data and return the formatted result.

skills.name: Skill Packager
